title: Italian Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty Italian-inspired skillet dish featuring andouille sausage, kissed by the flavors of caramel and ukrainian spices.

ingredients.name: Caramelized Onion
ingredients.notes: Slow cook in a skillet with 2 tbsp of olive oil until dark brown

ingredients.name: Kissed Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince and cook in the skillet until fragrant

ingredients.name: Skillet-Roasted Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice and cook in the skillet with the sausage and onions

instructions: In a large skillet, cook the andouille sausage over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the ukrainian spice blend to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the caramelized onion and kissed garlic to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the skillet-roasted potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the sausage is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
